indicators.meaning: Power is on and the router has started normally.
The router is starting up or installing a firmware update. Do not unplug it.
The router is powered and connected to your devices, but it cannot reach the internet.
The router is trying and failing to reach the internet, usually a broken link to the provider.
The internet cable or the provider line has a hard fault.
The Wi-Fi radio is switched off.
The router is connected to the internet and working normally.
Wi-Fi is switched on and working normally.
Wi-Fi is on and data is moving over it. This is normal.

E1.meaning: The drum is not filling with water.

E3.meaning: The water is not draining out of the drum.

UE.meaning: The load is unbalanced in the drum.

LE.meaning: The door lock has not engaged.

ok_normal.title: Normal operation
fix_steps: Nothing to fix. This light is behaving normally.

ok_power.title: Normal operation
fix_steps: Nothing to fix. The power light is behaving normally.

router_booting.title: Router is starting up
fix_steps: Wait about five minutes without unplugging the router.
If the light is still blinking after ten minutes, unplug the power for thirty seconds and plug it back in.

router_no_internet.title: Router cannot reach the internet
fix_steps: Unplug the router's power for thirty seconds, then plug it back in and wait three minutes.
Check that the cable in the port labelled WAN is pushed in firmly at both ends.
Try the same cable in another port on the provider's box, if there is one.
If the internet light is still orange, book a technician.

router_wan_fault.title: Internet line fault
fix_steps: Replace the WAN cable with a known-good one.
If the light stays red, the line itself needs a technician.

router_wifi_off.title: Wi-Fi switched off
fix_steps: Press the Wi-Fi button on the side of the router for two seconds.
The Wi-Fi light should turn green within ten seconds.

washer_no_water.title: No water inlet
fix_steps: Make sure the tap behind the machine is fully open.
Check the inlet hose for kinks.
Clean the inlet filter at the back of the machine.
If E1 returns, book a technician.

washer_drain_blocked.title: Drain blocked
fix_steps: Switch the machine off and unplug it.
Open the small service flap at the bottom front and clean the drain filter.
Check the drain hose for kinks.
If E3 returns, book a technician.

washer_unbalanced.title: Unbalanced load
fix_steps: Pause the cycle and redistribute the laundry evenly.
Avoid washing a single heavy item on its own.

washer_door_lock.title: Door lock fault
fix_steps: Open the door and check that nothing is caught in the seal.
Close it firmly until it clicks.
If LE returns, book a technician.
